Bug_Title: "wait" should not be called when multiple locks are held
Bug_Explanation: In the noncompliant code example, when two locks are held simultaneously, a wait call only releases one of them. The other will be held until some other thread requests a lock on the awaited object. If no unrelated code tries to lock on that object, then all other threads will be locked out, resulting in a deadlock.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by creating two threads that each call the'showBug' method. The'showBug' method acquires two locks and then waits for the second lock to be released. If the locks were not properly released, the second thread will hang indefinitely.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results confirm the presence of the bug. The test case does not release the locks acquired by the first thread, resulting in a deadlock. The bug is triggered when all conditions for a deadlock are met.
